summary: Boundless Bio filed an 8-K to report entering Amendment No. 1 to its Agreement and Plan of Merger with Serapha Bio, under which Boundless's subsidiary will merge into Serapha, making Serapha a wholly owned subsidiary. The amendment clarifies definitions, converts Serapha RSUs into Boundless RSUs adjusted by the exchange ratio, allows pre-funded warrants at $0.00001 per share as merger consideration to respect beneficial ownership limits, and lowers the voting standard for increasing authorized shares to a majority of votes cast. The original merger was announced June 22, 2026. No financial terms were disclosed. Watch for shareholder vote and closing conditions.
